cognitive_contract.label: Model / translate (Standard Olympiad)
cognitive_contract.decisive_act: Mathematize unstructured real-world conditions by defining variables and formulating simultaneous algebraic constraint equations.
cognitive_contract.band_protected_work: Require learner to perform the abstract variable assignment and constraint formulation to produce the governing system W.
cognitive_contract.support_posture: Highlight independent conservation principles without formulating the system of equations.

slots.X: the bivariate linear constraint system modeling ticket counts and revenue
slots.Y: given 50 total tickets, $10 student price, $25 adult price, $800 total revenue
slots.Z: mathematizing count and value conservation into simultaneous equations
slots.wrong_idea: swapping price coefficients (25x + 10y = 800) or equating count to revenue (x + y = 800)
slots.replacement_rule: formulate item conservation x + y = 50, then value conservation 10x + 25y = 800, simplifying by 5
slots.visual_job: render clean side-by-side constraint table mapping unit counts and prices

core2_custody.stem_requirement: Exact real-world context parameters, options with authentic modeling misconception traps
core2_custody.hint_ladder_requirement: H1 conceptual conservation nudge, H2 tactical raw equations; preserves W
core2_custody.solution_requirement: Locked pre-commit; step-by-step why-valid derivation with substitution check
core2_custody.distractor_requirement: Every distractor explained with specific student misconception

core1a_declarative.anti_leak_rule: Strict prohibition on leaking Core 2 exact parameters (50, 10, 25, 800, 160) in Core 1A text

core2a_supported_practice.crux_alignment: Identical crux move with progressive hints and after-commit unit link
core2a_supported_practice.navigation: Data attribute data-core-unit-id binding to ALG-LINE-MODEL-02

core2b_transfer.perturbation_rule: Vary to non-linear geometric boundary constraint modeling
core2b_transfer.verification: Confirm learner derivation W transferred without memorization

rules.T01_PRECOMMIT_OPTION_STYLING: Pre-commit option styling must not disclose the keyed answer via green borders, classes, or attributes
rules.T02_SUMMARY_ANSWER_LEAK: Summary elements must not disclose the answer letter or key prior to attempt commitment
rules.T03_SOLUTION_PRECOMMIT_UNLOCKED: Solution container must be inert and hidden prior to learner commitment
rules.T04_SCORE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: Difficulty score must be within [3, 5] for Band D2
rules.T05_CRUX_MOVE_REF_MISSING: Question must declare a valid crux_move reference
rules.T06_KATEX_RENDER_DEFECT: HTML must not contain KaTeX error spans or unescaped macro issues
rules.T07_CORE1A_PARAMETER_LEAK: Core 1A declarative study must not leak Core 2 specific question parameters or answers
rules.T08_CORE1B_PRECOMMIT_ANSWER_LEAK: Core 1B reconstruction must enforce answer_before_attempt: FORBIDDEN
rules.T09_CORE2A_UNIT_NAV_MISSING: Core 2A must provide explicit question-specific unit navigation
rules.T10_EMPTY_HINT: Hints must provide meaningful question-specific guidance
rules.T11_PRECOMMIT_PROTECTED_W_LEAK: Pre-commit hints must not leak protected work W (the formulated system of equations)
rules.T12_CORE_P2_TOPIC_ONLY_NO_QUESTION_UNIT: HTML must target a source-declared question-specific Core1 unit
rules.T13_HINT_PROGRESSIVE_SEQUENCE_MISSING: Hint sequence must progress from H1 conceptual nudge to H2 tactical step
rules.T14_SOURCE_CUSTODY_INTEGRITY: Source question must maintain verified provenance and custody hash
